1.consolidated_definition: Cierta clase de polvo acaso extraído, real o supuestamente, de las uñas del tapir o anta suramericano.
1.en_consolidated_definition: A certain type of dust allegedly extracted from the hooves or supposed to be derived from the hooves of the South American tapir or anta.
